text: We all lose dollars every month on services we no longer use. The easiest habit to start today is a five-minute subscription audit on the first of every month. Just open your banking app, scroll through the recurring charges, and cancel anything you haven't touched or used in the last 30 days. It’s not about deprivation; it’s about reclaiming your resources and your mental space. Small checks like this add up to significant savings over time.
